Course of Study
A. Programme of Study :
The college offers two (2) Streams of study viz. Arts& Science. It provides facilities for the following programmes:
1. Two year Higher Secondary Course in Arts & Science
2. Three year Degree Course(comprised of 6 Semesters) in Arts & Science
B. Combination of Subjects for H.S Course :
1. Two year Higher Secondary Course : Arts & Science
a . Compulsory Subjects (Arts & Science)
i. English
ii. Alt. English / MIL (Assamese)
iii. Environmental Education (only for H.S. 1st Year)
b . Elective Subjects (ARTS)
Students are allowed to opt for four (4) of the following subjects of which  one(1) will be considered as additional.
i. Economics
ii. Political-Science
iii. Education
iv. History
v. Sociology
vi. Mathematics
c . Elective Subjects (SCIENCE)
Students are allowed to opt for four (4) of the following subjects of which  one(1) will be considered as additional.
i. Biology
ii. Chemistry
iii. Mathematics
iv. Physics
